info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to query wholesale trading data based on specified parameters. By utilizing an identifier, users can retrieve detailed market order information, facilitating insights into trading activities. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, trading platforms, and enterprise resource planning systems. It supports various use cases, such as performance analysis and reporting for market orders, thus aiding stakeholders in making informed trading decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific market order by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific market order identified by the unique resource ID. It provides comprehensive information about the order, including its current status, specifications, and related data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data specific to the market order identified by 'RES-100045'. It requires the inclusion of necessary identifiers and parameters as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the market order details.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Request.description: A request body representation for the Market Order operation in the Wholesale Trading API.

tradingBookId.description: Unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: Unique identifier for the financial instrument.

side.description: Indicates whether the order is a buy or sell order.

quantity.description: Number of units of the instrument to buy or sell.

timeInForce.description: Indicates how long the order will remain active (e.g., GTC, FOK).

venue.description: Market venue where the order is submitted.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record (e.g., active, cancelled).

version.description: Version number of the market order.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the market order.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Response_200.description: Represents the response structure for retrieving market order information.

currency.description: The currency in which the limit price is denominated.

LimitPrice.description: Represents the limit price for an order.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the market order response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer Authentication, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) for authorization. Clients must include the token in the Authorization header of their requests to access protected resources.
